problem: A strict AC1021 TABLE output could contain a group-2 anonymous block name without a corresponding emitted block record and body; ODA re-export of a generated candidate reported an empty AcDbTable record name.

authority.finding: TABLE group 2 identifies the referenced block; anonymous TABLE blocks begin with *T.

implementation.change: Strict TABLE output reuses the INSERT resolver for source handle/name and planned BLOCK_RECORD, and the shared block-body closure preflight inside the entity transaction. An unresolved target fails with a TABLE-specific diagnostic. Non-strict TABLE fallback remains unchanged.
implementation.limitations: The check does not establish TABLE value semantics, source graph completeness beyond the referenced block checks, or native CAD support.

validation.result: PASS 2/2. The TABLE test covers ASCII and binary strict refusal of a missing block, destination and identity preservation, and corrected same-writer retry with a block record/body. The existing block-owner test also passes.
validation.inventory: A clean configure without local sample fixtures registered 1401 tests. The frozen inventory was refreshed: it adds the new strict block target and two previously registered AC1021/AC1024 TABLE tests omitted by the previous 1398-name inventory. check-inventory and workflow contract pass.
preexistingFailures: libdxfrw_table_export_reuse fails during cross-version imported-data output in dictionary-with-default records before reaching the new control.
libdxfrw_table_value_payload exits failure without additional diagnostics.
Both failures reproduce with the same test object and adapter linked to the pre-change c31185da static library; this establishes they predate this writer change, not their root cause.

limits: No independent ODA run on the corrected generated output was performed in this slice.
No broad suite or platform requalification was run. P5-I and P8 qualification remain open.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added or staged.
